sentences.text: Batteries give off explosive hydrogen gas while charging, so battery compartments need ventilation, and batteries must be secured so they can’t shift in a seaway, with terminals covered.
Use marine-rated wiring, breakers and fuses, since many boat fires start with electrical faults.
Inspect shore power cords and connectors for heat damage.
Faulty wiring can energize the water around docks, especially in fresh or brackish water, so never let anyone swim near a marina or dock with shore power.
